Muslim panchayat member performs Hindu man's last rites in Kerala

A Muslim panchayat member in Kerala performed the last rites for a Hindu man after his family reportedly declined to do so. The incident highlights a unique act of communal harmony and respect for the deceased, transcending religious lines. This event has garnered attention for its unusual nature and the gesture of goodwill it represents.
